title: Operation Overlord with Bodyguard and Fortitude deceptions

tellings.quote: So invasion of the operation overlord D-Day and the beaches of Normandy was cool. and Operation Bodyguard and Fortitude were fake because we never actually invaded Norway as we said we were going to do.

plain: In 1944 the Allies made one real invasion and faked another, according to a researcher named Eric Weinstein. He says Operation Overlord, the D-Day landing on the beaches of Normandy, was the real thing, while Operations Bodyguard and Fortitude were made-up plans meant to make the enemy think an invasion of Norway was coming: "we never actually invaded Norway as we said we were going to do." He uses it as an example of how a government can run a true story and a false one side by side.
